g.text: PORTFOLIO (PIN file — tribunal-ready, job-winning): PIN + renewals, CPD log
(certificates, hours, reflections), appraisals, competencies signed, incident learnings,
compliments + complaints with responses, teaching given, audits joined. Update quarterly;
reflect monthly (Gibbs above); de-identify patients ALWAYS (M4/M6: Act 843).
EXAM COUNTDOWN (licensing + interviews): 6 weeks out — syllabus map + weak
topics (this course's 42 objectives); 4 weeks — past questions timed + rationales; 2 weeks —
rapid-review cards (Act numbers, 4-box, ISBAR, 8 rules, 5 delegation rights, 4 negligence
elements); 1 week — mock OSCE/exam conditions + sleep; eve — pack PIN slip, ID, pens,
rest (cramming curdles judgment). Day: read twice, answer asked, structure (compass!),
cite Acts + Code, attempt all, review. Interviews: STAR stories (Situation-Task-Action-
Result) from reflections; \"tell me about an ethical dilemma\" = compass aloud.

before sedation · 5 U/IU/zeros banned · 6 copy-paste forbidden · 7 verbal orders read-back ·
